name: Post card
description: One post in a list (index, archive, related posts): image, category, date, title, excerpt, author. The whole card links to the post.

layout.description: Image on top, image beside the text, or text only with a divider.

surface.description: plain: no surface. card: its own background (--color-card), radius and shadow (--shadow-card), the text padded (--spacing-card) and the image flush at the edge, as theme cards are drawn on a tinted page.

byline.description: inline: category · date above the title. below: the category above the title and author / date under it, both in the accent colour, small and semibold.

locale.description: Locale the date is written in (site.language).

headingLevel.description: Title heading level in the page outline.

linkTitle.description: The title in the site's link colour (--color-link), as themes that colour every link do.

sizes.description: The image's `sizes` hint; absent, the card's own guess. A list passes the slot its columns give.

imageHeight.description: The image block's height as the source sets it (a CSS length or clamp()), cropped to fit; wins over imageAspect.

imageAspect.description: The image block's aspect ratio (16 / 9) where the source sets an aspect ratio; absent, 16 / 9.

excerptLines.description: Clamp the excerpt to this many lines; absent, the layout's own (3 vertical, 2 otherwise).

a11y: An <article> with one link (the title), stretched over the card; the category link sits above it and stays separately focusable. Dates are <time datetime>.
